mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.real_name as publisher_name, d.dept_name, d.dept_code FROM sys_announcement a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.publisher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON a.dept_id = d.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_announcement (title, content, announcement_type, scope, dept_id, publisher_id, publish_time, deadline, is_top, top_order, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{announcementType}, #{scope}, #{deptId}, #{publisherId}, #{publishTime}, #{deadline}, #{isTop}, #{topOrder}, #{status})
mapper.delete: UPDATE sys_announcement SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_announcement SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
